credit_line: Gift of Juan and Anna Marie Hamilton
description: Sheer white Blouse with pleat front and neck tie, button cuffs, flaram embroidery on placket.  Darts on front. Lingerie. Stand collar with ties, button front, vertical pin tracks, front and back cuffs.  Note: has label M.Vernet Paris; cutwork on sleeves and front; blue embroidery down front - 2 little stars and running down front - lace trim down front and on sleeves; waist darts front and back.  not 1930s but later; combo-hand and machine stitching; lace at end of ties.
title: Blouse
